rationale: The agent did not fully satisfy the user’s requests or adhere to policy. While it looked up the user and order and changed the payment method, it failed to: (1) provide the gift card balance; (2) determine or explain whether the gift card balance could be applied to the order; and (3) obtain explicit user confirmation before performing an order-changing write (it executed modify_pending_order_payment without confirming). Although it implied the prior card was Mastercard by mentioning a refund, it did not first confirm the action as required, and did not address all requested information. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar.
